doc: Ocean-minus-land contrast over x = |lat| / phi_H from 0 to 4 (the convergence dip, the extratropical plateau, the desert dip under the highs, the fade past 2.2), the knees, a polar x of 1e6 and a negative x (the gaussians are even, the ramps clip). Constants -0.08, 0.12, 0.04 are read from the source. Float64 closed form: 1e-9 (measured against math-module scalars: bit-identical to a math-module scalar evaluation on this machine (6e-17 at most for exp)). params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
